episode_summary: In this episode, Justin Black shares how he uses AI to generate nearly $5 million in listings by optimizing his online presence for AI search results. He discusses the importance of creating content that answers real client questions and how to effectively use expired listings as a source of business. Justin also provides insights into building a website that attracts AI attention and the role of positioning in real estate success.
